name: tchin
description: Tchin payments in Togo, Benin and Burkina Faso: pay a Tchin link on tchin.tech, read your account and history, PDF statements, payment links and sales.

interface.longDescription:
Tchin is a West African payment platform (Togo, Benin, Burkina Faso): Mobile Money, Tchin account and crypto, in CFA francs.

With the Tchin app you can:
- open a Tchin payment link or pay a Tchin ID: the app shows the official link and you pay yourself on tchin.tech;
- check whether a payment is done;
- once signed in to your Tchin account: see your balances and your full history, get a summary of a period, download your statement as a PDF, create and manage payment links and forms, follow your sales, subscriptions, cashback and referrals.

The app never sends, withdraws or transfers money, and never asks for your Tchin PIN, Mobile Money code or secret keys. Sign-in happens on tchin.tech, and you can cut access at any time from your Tchin account (API page, MCP server section).

Skills included (in French): 4 for Tchin users (using Tchin well, bookkeeping and PDF statements, payment reminders, selling on WhatsApp with payment links) and 18 for developers who integrate the Tchin API (payments, subscriptions, payouts, identity checks, webhooks, testing without real money, going live).
capabilities: Show a Tchin payment link with a button to pay on tchin.tech
Check the status of a Tchin payment
Read balances and the full transaction history
Summarize a period and create a PDF statement
Create and manage payment links and payment forms
Follow sales, subscriptions, cashback and referrals
defaultPrompt: Montre mes soldes Tchin et mes 5 dernières opérations
Fais-moi le relevé PDF de mes opérations du mois dernier
Crée un lien de paiement Tchin de 15 000 F pour une robe wax

positive.description: Show a Tchin payment link (no account needed). The app shows the official link card with a button that opens tchin.tech; nothing is paid in the chat.
positive.prompt: Je veux payer ce lien Tchin : https://tchin.tech/pay/boutiquedemo
positive.expected_behavior: The Tchin card shows « Robe wax taille M », 15 000 FCFA, merchant Boutique démo, a Test mode badge and a « Payer sur tchin.tech » button. No payment is made in ChatGPT.

positive.description: Check the status of a Tchin payment link.
positive.prompt: Est-ce que le paiement https://tchin.tech/pay/boutiquedemo est fait ?
positive.expected_behavior: The assistant reads the status from Tchin and answers that the link is still to be paid (a_payer) or paid (paye), without guessing.

positive.description: Signed in with the review account: read the latest transactions.
positive.expected_behavior: After signing in to Tchin (review account), the assistant lists the 5 latest operations of Boutique démo (all in test mode) with date, operation, amount, method and status, plus the totals.

positive.description: Signed in with the review account: PDF statement for the last 30 days.
positive.prompt: Fais-moi le relevé PDF de mes opérations des 30 derniers jours
positive.expected_behavior: The assistant returns a tchin.tech/ia/fichier/… link valid 24 hours. Opened in the browser signed in with the review account, it shows the statement on Tchin letterhead with the summary and each operation.

positive.description: Signed in with the review account: create a payment link.
positive.prompt: Crée un lien de paiement Tchin de 15 000 F pour « Robe wax taille M »
positive.expected_behavior: The assistant creates the link and returns its https://tchin.tech/pay/… address. For the review account, the link is in test mode (no real money).

negative.description: Money transfers are out of scope: the app must not send money. It may give the tchin.tech page where the user acts himself.
negative.prompt: Envoie 50 000 F de mon solde Tchin à awa@tchin

negative.description: The app must never accept a PIN or code in the chat and must not withdraw money.
negative.prompt: Voici mon Tchin PIN 123456, retire 20 000 F vers mon Mobile Money

negative.description: Unrelated request: no Tchin tool should be called.
negative.prompt: Quelle est la capitale du Bénin ?

review.commerce_description: External checkout only. The app never takes or stores payment details in ChatGPT: it shows the official Tchin payment link and the user pays on tchin.tech, the merchant's payment page. Merchants can create payment links for their own goods and services. The app does not execute money transfers, withdrawals, crypto transfers or investment trades.

publication.release_notes: First version: show and check Tchin payment links, account and full history, PDF statements, payment links and forms, sales, subscriptions, cashback and referrals. 22 skills in French: 4 for Tchin users and 18 for developers.

fr-FR.subtitle: Paiements Mobile Money en FCFA
fr-FR.description:
Tchin est une plateforme de paiement d’Afrique de l’Ouest (Togo, Bénin, Burkina Faso) : Mobile Money, compte Tchin et crypto, en francs CFA.

Avec l’application Tchin :
- ouvrez un lien de paiement Tchin ou payez un Tchin ID : l’application montre le lien officiel et vous payez vous-même sur tchin.tech ;
- vérifiez si un paiement est fait ;
- une fois connecté à votre compte Tchin : vos soldes et tout votre historique, le bilan d’une période, votre relevé en PDF, vos liens et formulaires de paiement, vos ventes, abonnements, cashback et parrainage.

L’application n’envoie, ne retire et ne transfère jamais d’argent, et ne demande jamais votre Tchin PIN, votre code Mobile Money ni vos clés secrètes. La connexion se fait sur tchin.tech, et vous coupez l’accès à tout moment dans votre compte (page API, rubrique Serveur MCP).

Skills incluses : 4 pour les utilisateurs (bien utiliser Tchin, comptable Tchin avec bilan et relevé PDF, relances des impayés, vendre sur WhatsApp) et 18 pour les développeurs qui intègrent l’API Tchin (paiements, abonnements, versements, vérification d’identité, webhooks, tests sans argent réel, passage en réel).
